description: Use this when wiring tls.Config into a new SDK client that dials a remote endpoint — TLS 1.2 floor (1.3 preferred), SNI ServerName required, mTLS via LoadX509KeyPair, custom CA layered on x509.SystemCertPool, and ErrTLS sentinel wrapping. Covers Mozilla / CIS / NIST guidance. Triggers: tls.Config, MinVersion, RootCAs, ServerName, InsecureSkipVerify, x509.SystemCertPool, LoadX509KeyPair.
